# hudu_asset (Resource)

Manages a Hudu asset.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hudu_asset" "laptop_001" {
  company_id      = hudu_company.acme.id
  asset_layout_id = hudu_asset_layout.computer.id

  name                 = "LAPTOP-001"
  primary_serial       = "SN123456"
  primary_model        = "X1 Carbon"
  primary_manufacturer = "Lenovo"

  custom_fields = {
    operating_system = "Linux"
    serial_number    = "SN123456"
    purchase_date    = "2024/01/15"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `asset_layout_id` (Number) Layout ID. Changing this forces a new asset.
- `company_id` (Number) Owning company ID. Changing this forces a new asset.
- `name` (String) Asset name.

### Optional

- `custom_fields` (Dynamic) Custom fields for the asset, as an object literal keyed by the layout field's label converted to snake_case (lowercase, spaces become underscores). Values may be strings, numbers, booleans, lists, or nested objects (for Address fields). Example:

```hcl
custom_fields = {
  operating_system = "Linux"
  score            = 5
  is_active        = true
  categories       = ["Item 1", "Item 2"]
  office_location  = {
    address_line_1 = "123 Main St"
    city           = "Denver"
    state          = "CO"
    zip            = "80202"
    country_name   = "USA"
  }
}
```
- `primary_mail` (String) Primary email address associated with the asset.
- `primary_manufacturer` (String) Primary manufacturer of the asset.
- `primary_model` (String) Primary model of the asset.
- `primary_serial` (String) Primary serial number of the asset.

### Read-Only

- `asset_type` (String) Name of the asset layout this asset belongs to, as reported by Hudu.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp the asset was created, in ISO 8601 UTC (e.g. `2026-01-15T12:34:56.789Z`).
- `id` (String) Numeric ID assigned by Hudu, as a string.
- `slug` (String) URL slug generated by Hudu.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp the asset was last updated, in ISO 8601 UTC.
- `url` (String) Absolute URL of the asset in the Hudu web UI.
